text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан gives it her all, but she loses
to
Мэдзиро МакКуин, who has spent her
entire life
preparing for the spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
McQueen respects Ryan's effort, and
promises
that their next race will be
medium
distance—Ryan's specialty.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen,
which
decides the spring
medium-distance champion.
But will
Мэдзиро Райан be able to place high
enough
in the fan poll to enter?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
